title: Ponylands [DTC]

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
I have some feedback:
- Lower the cores. They're too close to the trees and it can be reached by shifting out to the edge of the tree and breaking it there. I think it'd be better if people who come out of spawn have a better reach of the core so they can defend it, or at least be able to have a better perspective of enemies.
- Remove the bridge with the fences going towards front lines above the water. It's restricting and narrow, I'd remove it so people can build out to the front lines and choose top or bottom of they want. It'll be much more easier for navigation and it will have selective routes.

It's a good map, I will XML it for you if you can do the above two things.
